Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with this custom American football bedding set from Jeminise. Featuring a bold retro design, this comforter or duvet cover is perfect for football players, fans, and coaches who want to bring the spirit of the game into their daily space.

Key Features

  • Custom Options: Features 2 customizable text inputs to personalize with your chosen name and number.
  • Product Type Options: Available as either a lightweight duvet cover designed for inserts or a cozy, all-in-one comforter filled with soft microfiber.
  • Material Details: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester microfiber fabric for a soft, breathable, and lightweight feel.
  • Available Sizes: Comes in standard US Twin (68x88 in / 68x90 in), Full (78x88 in / 79x90 in), Queen (88x88 in / 90x90 in), and King (104x88 in / 104x90 in).
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick-drying, and tumble dry on low heat for easy maintenance.
  • Included Components: Includes 1 duvet cover or comforter, with options to add matching pillowcases or an additional flat sheet.

Transform your bedroom space with the custom sports-themed bedding set from Jeminise. This custom bedding features a vintage football design with a football player flag pattern, offering a soft feel and a layer of breathable warmth that is perfect for football players, fans, and sports lovers.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customization options support up to 2 text inputs for personalized name and number.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Lightweight & Durable: Lightweight material with smooth, fine, and compact stitching along the edges for lasting durability.
  • Included Components: Package includes 1 Duvet Cover or Comforter with optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, air dry without heat, or tumble dry on low heat.

Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with the custom Galaxy Football Flag Comforter by Jeminise.   • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88") beds.

research_snapshot.body_html:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with the custom Galaxy Football Flag Comforter by Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and coaches, this high-quality bedding features a vibrant sports design that brings the energy of the game into your home decor. Customizable with text options, this comforter is designed to deliver both modern style and exceptional comfort.

Key Features

  • Customized Design: Features up to two text inputs for names, numbers, or custom messages to create a personalized sports keepsake.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88") beds.
  • Included Components: Set includes 1 comforter (or duvet cover) with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet covers.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; quick-drying microfiber becomes fluffier with each wash.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Galaxy Football Flag
Theme Football
Pattern Galaxy
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
